source_snapshot.items: UFM Telemetry TMS setup and trial run - Run IB-Stress
source_snapshot.procedure: Assign 10.10.10.1/16 to node-1 ibp79s0f0 and 10.10.10.2/16 to node-2 ibp206s0; run ib_write_bw server on mlx5_4 and client on mlx5_10 with port 11000 and --run_infinitely; inspect telemetry.
source_snapshot.criteria: UFM panels record correct information, network status agrees with the nodes, and the view records the configured time.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Generic UFM workflow with unrelated subnet-merge/topology-deploy risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; exact interface/HCA mapping, isolation, finite duration, pre/post network state, telemetry-time semantics and cleanup are required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes UFM/fabric dependency but misses static-IP mutations, explicit devices and unbounded bandwidth workers.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores the exact traffic path and converts the infinite run into a supervised bounded execution.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row420 configures the telemetry view; row422 performs UFM cable validation.

original_test_intent: Generate controlled InfiniBand write traffic between two approved nodes and verify UFM telemetry records the correct path, values, node state and configured time window.
original_method: Map both netdevs and mlx5 devices to approved ports/GIDs and physical nodes; save addresses/routes/link state; prove the 10.10.10.0/16 addresses are collision-free and isolated; apply addresses; start the approved finite ib_write_bw server and client under an external supervisor; correlate UFM panel timestamps/rates with endpoint counters; stop workers; restore network state and retain logs.
manual_activity: Fabric owner approves the two-node path and isolation; operator confirms physical identity and watches UFM rendering/recovery.
safety_requirements: Never use --run_infinitely without external hard timeout
Do not alter a management path
Stop on link, routing, counter, thermal or fabric anomaly
Always terminate both peers and restore state; no auto-retry
engineer_actions: Define telemetry correctness and time tolerance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic SSH/UI access is insufficient and its subnet-merge warning is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After mapping approval, run the exact two ib_write_bw roles with a finite supervisor instead of --run_infinitely, while sampling endpoint and UFM timestamps/counters; restore addresses/routes afterward.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source interfaces, IPs, mlx5 devices, report_gbits and port 11000 retained; infinite duration is preserved as intent only and bounded for safe execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a phase-gated, time-bounded two-node bandwidth run with synchronized endpoint/UFM evidence and exact network restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds device identity proof, collision/isolation checks, external watchdog, explicit telemetry oracle and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Dashboard configuration alone cannot prove live telemetry correlation under traffic.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong netdev/HCA/IP mapping can disrupt routing; an unbounded worker can consume fabric indefinitely; UFM values need aligned units and timestamps.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define device mapping, allowed address scope, message/depth/QP profile, duration, acceptable rate delta and timestamp skew, telemetry retention, and whether temporary addresses may coexist with existing routes.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's subnet-merge/topology-deploy risk is copied and unrelated; Master and GPT V2 consistently describe a two-node IB traffic and telemetry correlation test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution is gated by the exact path, isolation, finite traffic envelope, telemetry oracle and rollback.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row421 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00004-V002: approve node/netdev/mlx5/port/GID mapping, collision-free isolated IP/prefix/routes, finite ib_write_bw profile/duration/watchdog, telemetry metrics/units/timestamp tolerance, alternate access and exact network rollback.

review_improvement: Turns an unbounded, mutable two-node recipe into a bounded and reversible measurement with endpoint-to-UFM correlation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The Linux netdev and verbs device names are independently enumerated and can change across firmware or PCI topology, so both must be proven to reach the intended ports before assigning addresses. UFM correctness requires comparing synchronized endpoint counters to the same link and time interval, not merely observing a populated panel.
